environment: isolated Podman ARM64 Linux VM, 1 CPU and 2 GiB
operation: Start the guest and observe its helper and /usr/bin/sleep 6 child through /proc; SIGKILL guest; sample helper and child after 0.5 seconds, comparing PID start times and non-zombie state. Cleanup only observed owned processes.
scope: Test-only compiler byte-patch of the measured base's embedded ARM64 runtime region; it is not a rebuilt or qualified compiler. One successful simple direct-child kill on Linux ARM64; no normal completion/refusal coverage, runtime setup race, x86, macOS, grandchildren, escaped processes, lock, or resource governor. Python is only a test observer and staging tool.
